MEETING MINUTES - Product Planning Review
Date: {DATE}
Location: Conference Room B

Attendees:
{P1} ({P1.dept})
{P2} ({P2.dept})
{P3} ({P3.dept})

Agenda: Release schedule for next quarter

Discussion: The design review window will be extended by one week. Development timelines stay the same, and the impact of the change will be checked again at next week's meeting.

Minutes recorded by: {P1.s}

[Team chat - #welcome]
{P1.g}: Hi everyone! I just started as {P1.job} at {P1.org} this week, so I'm still finding my way around.
{P2.g}: Welcome aboard, {P1.g}! Happy to show you the ropes.
{P1.g}: Thanks! Is there a good place to grab lunch nearby?
{P2.g}: The noodle place on the second floor is the usual favorite. Let's go Thursday.

Community Spotlight

{P1} was born on {P1.dob} in a small river town and grew up helping a relative repair furniture. For the past twenty years, they have run a neighborhood woodworking studio that teaches local teenagers the basics of the craft. The spring open house will feature a dozen chairs and shelves built by hand.

Details are posted at {PLACE} and on the studio's notice board.

Just got back from the {PLACE} trail run! Ten miles in the cold, but worth every step. Huge thanks to everyone who kept pace with me at the back. The group photos are up on the club page. The photographer's handle is {P1.handle} if you want to tag them. Next session is next Saturday, see you there! #trailrun #weekendmiles

JOB OPENING

{ORG} is looking for a Customer Data Analyst to join our growing team.

Responsibilities: build monthly reporting dashboards, review data quality, and support the product team with analysis.
Requirements: three or more years in analytics, strong SQL skills, and experience with a visualization tool.
Employment type: Full-time, five days a week
Location: Head office, with hybrid working available
Closing date: {DATE}

To apply, send your CV and portfolio to {ORG.email}. For recruitment questions, call {ORG.phone}. {ORG} is an equal opportunity employer.
